Hey everyone!

There is a great conversation going on over in TIL regarding bans and the future of the moderation rules for that sub. Reading it gave me an idea about bans that I thought wasn't really appropriate to share there so I figured I would turn to ideasforvoat.

Why not give the option, when banning someone, to ban for X amount of time and keep a record of the bans that each person has accrued. So if someone is behaving badly they could get banned from /v/whatever for maybe a week. And if they come back and engage normally for a while but a few months later start acting up again the Mod can bring up their profile and see that they were banned for X time on XYZ date for ABC reason. Now maybe they get banned for a month. Maybe the third time they get a lifetime ban from the sub.

Also, I feel like there could be some valuable utility in someones bans being available for viewing, maybe for everyone on their profile or maybe for just mods. I don't know which option would be better.

But then if someone is banned from one sub for ABC reason and then they are acting up in another sub the same way the mod there can see that their behavior is not isolated to their sub, they can see that the user was doing the same thing elsewhere and this might be useful information when trying to decide if someone is really a troll or just has issues with articulation, impulsivity, or unpopular opinions.

Thoughts?
Bans: How they can work (Ban for X time?), how to handle them, and information on users
